title: {{NAME}} and the Fairy Princess of the Flower Hill
moral: A small act of kindness can make someone's whole day bright.
character_anchor: Bright children's book cartoon illustration, bold outlines, vivid flat colours. {{NAME}}, a young boy with brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a soft lilac shirt with a small flower embroidery, cream trousers, and light brown sandals — same child, same face, same exact outfit in every image.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} climbed up a big, round flower hill.
The hill was covered in yellow and white flowers.
Bluebirds and butterflies flew all around.
At the very top sat a tiny princess.
She was so small. As small as a butterfly.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} reached the top and looked carefully.
The tiny princess had fairy wings.
She wore a dress the colour of roses.
"Oh!" said {{NAME}}. He held very still.
She looked up and smiled at him.

pages.content:
"My wand is lost in the tall grass," she said.
Without it, the flowers were turning grey.
All the animals looked very sad.
{{NAME}} got down on his hands and knees.
He searched through every blade of grass.

pages.content:
A little hedgehog sniffed at something shiny.
{{NAME}} looked. It was the wand!
He picked it up so gently.
He held it out to the tiny princess.
She grabbed it and the flowers turned bright again.

pages.content:
All the flowers glowed bright and beautiful.
The bluebirds sang a happy song.
The tiny princess danced on her flower.
She waved her wand and {{NAME}} felt warm all over.
{{NAME}} sat in the soft grass and felt very sleepy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Tomorrow the princess wants to show you her secret fairy palace.
